name: 85212 · Mesa, AZ
findings: ZIP 85212 (Mesa) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85212 (Mesa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85212 (Mesa) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
